nodes.label: n=24 Sobol: exp is the larger knob in EVERY stratum — population (0.73 vs 0.3...
nodes.statement: n=24 Sobol: exp is the larger knob in EVERY stratum — population (0.73 vs 0.37), both generations (0.72/0.75 vs 0.39/0.36), all three seeds (0.74/0.77/0.60 vs 0.40/0.29/0.41). Argmax does not flip → robust; the decoy is under the null so it is trustworthy. CONFIRMS the pre-registered hypothesis. NB this REVERSES the under-resolved n=12 2-gen result (trl_eff-leads, decoy 0.24–0.51) — whose own adversarial decoy had flagged it as untrustworthy.

The apparent gen1→gen2 trend at n=12 (exp falling) was an under-resolution artifact. Honest strategy-2 answer: the strategy choice does not change the ranking for this system.
